cues: Hives give honey, wax, propolis and royal jelly.
But their greatest value is pollination: eighty seven of the world's leading food crops depend on animal pollinators.
In Jumla, Apis cerana makes more than half of all visits to apple flowers.
Their enemies are the Varroa mite, sacbrood virus and foulbrood disease, wax moths and hornets.
